module.name: ibm_roks_cluster_install_flo
module.description: Install F5 Lifecycle Operator (FLO) into an existing IBM ROKS cluster, using credentials from the IBM Cloud Credential Template.

required.reason: cert-manager must be installed before FLO so the FLO ClusterIssuer/Certificate CRs resolve.

required.name: ibmcloud_api_key
required.description: IBM Cloud API key used to fetch cluster credentials and read COS resources.

required.name: ibmcloud_cluster_region
required.description: IBM Cloud region where the existing ROKS cluster resides.

required.name: roks_cluster_name_or_id
required.description: Existing IBM ROKS cluster name or ID where FLO will be installed.

optional.name: ibmcloud_resource_group
optional.description: IBM Cloud resource group used for cluster discovery and trusted-profile binding. Defaults to the value inherited from the selected IBM Cloud Credential Template, or 'default' if none is provided.

optional.name: cert_manager_crd_ready
optional.description: Set to true when cert-manager has been applied and its CRDs are registered.

optional.name: far_repo_url
optional.description: FAR Repository URL for Docker and Helm registry.

optional.name: f5_bigip_k8s_manifest_version
optional.description: Version of the f5-bigip-k8s-manifest chart (FLO/CIS versions are extracted from this).

optional.name: use_cos_bucket
optional.description: Fetch FAR auth key and JWT from IBM Cloud Object Storage.

optional.name: ibmcloud_cos_bucket_region
optional.description: IBM Cloud region where the COS bucket is located.

optional.name: ibmcloud_resources_cos_bucket
optional.description: IBM Cloud COS bucket containing the FAR auth key and JWT files.

optional.name: f5_cne_far_auth_file
optional.description: FAR auth key filename in the COS bucket (.tgz).

optional.name: f5_cne_subscription_jwt_file
optional.description: Subscription JWT filename in the COS bucket.

optional.name: bigip_username
optional.description: BIG-IP username for CIS controller login.

optional.name: bigip_password
optional.description: BIG-IP password for CIS controller login.

optional.name: bigip_url
optional.description: BIG-IP URL for CIS controller login.

optional.name: nad_cni_type
optional.description: CNI type for NAD (host-device or ipvlan).

optional.name: nad_interface_name
optional.description: Network interface name for NAD (e.g., ens7, eth1).

optional.name: nad_ipvlan_mode
optional.description: IPVLAN mode (l2 or l3) — only used when nad_cni_type is ipvlan.

key_outputs.name: flo_release_name
key_outputs.description: Name of the f5-lifecycle-operator Helm release.

key_outputs.name: flo_utils_namespace
key_outputs.description: Namespace where f5-lifecycle-operator utils are installed.

key_outputs.name: flo_trusted_profile_id
key_outputs.description: IBM IAM Trusted Profile ID created for the CNE controller service account.

required.name: ibmcloud_api_key
required.description: IBM Cloud credential template or project secret providing the API key.
